review:
The Dog House Multihold puts the dogs on a 5×3 grid where wilds carry a 2x or 3x multiplier, added together when several are in one win.

Three bonus symbols trigger seven free spins on one grid. Three scatters unlock a second grid, then a third and a fourth, each adding one to three spins. Wilds that land on the newest grid copy across to the newly unlocked ones and stay sticky for the rest of the round, so a strong first grid can fill all four. Pragmatic lists a 96.06% RTP. It suits players who like bonuses that grow as they go.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
